name: ledgerlens
description: Privacy-first personal expense tracker: statement + receipt ingestion, REST API, React analytics dashboard.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.demo: npm run build -w web && npm run demo -w server
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.verify: npm run check:privacy && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
